note: Jackson County, Iowa publishes no queryable zoning district service: its GIS data page offers only Beacon viewer access and data requests, and its zoning pages link to ordinance PDFs. Maquoketa publishes its zoning map as a dated PDF. The only queryable layer covering Maquoketa and Bellevue is an unofficial Iowa State University copy (zoning_districts_all_data_v2, layer 217) with 16 districts for the county; it fails validation (5 of 6 sampled polygons valid, 90% needed) and has no unincorporated county zoning, so it was not submitted.
